name: Electric field definition
meaning: Electric field is the force per unit charge on a small test charge q. Units N/C = V/m.

name: Speed of light from electromagnetism
meaning: The speed of EM waves in vacuum follows from the electric constant ε0 = 8.85×10⁻¹² C²/(N·m²) and the magnetic constant μ0 = 1.257×10⁻⁶ T·m/A.

name: Wave speed relation
meaning: Speed of light (m/s) equals wavelength (m) times frequency (Hz). Long wavelength means low frequency.

name: Period and frequency
meaning: The period (s) is the time for one cycle; frequency (Hz) is cycles per second.

name: Field ratio in an EM wave
meaning: In an EM wave in vacuum, the magnetic field amplitude (T) equals the electric field amplitude (V/m) divided by c.

name: Intensity of an EM wave
meaning: Average power per area (W/m²) carried by a wave of electric field amplitude E0 (V/m). Intensity grows as amplitude squared.

name: Unpolarized light through a polarizer
meaning: An ideal polarizer transmits half the intensity of unpolarized light.

name: Malus's law
meaning: Polarized light of intensity I0 hitting a polarizer at angle θ between its polarization and the axis emerges with intensity I.
